definitions.explanation: Someone who refuses to change their mind or yield, even when they know they are wrong. Also used as a な-adjective to describe such behavior.

examples.japanese: {意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{損|そん}をする→損をする：30214_sonwosuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Being stubborn sometimes works against you.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}りだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧にしない。
examples.english: He's so stubborn that he would never apologize first.

notes:
USAGE:
Can function as both a noun and a な-adjective ({意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧). Generally carries a negative nuance, suggesting someone is being unreasonably obstinate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (stubborn personality)
- {意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}りな⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (stubborn person)
- {意地|いじ}っ{張|ぱ}りで⟦{損|そん}をする→損をする：30214_sonwosuru⟧ (lose out by being stubborn)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{頑固|がんこ}→頑固：06643_ganko⟧: stubborn — more neutral, can imply steadfastness; often used for older people
- ⟦{強情|ごうじょう}→強情：18243_goujou⟧: obstinate — emphasizes refusal to yield, slightly more formal
